summary: Enhance your skills in environmental governance and policy development with our comprehensive training course. Join us to make a positive impact today!
lede: Environmental governance and policy development helps professionals shape decisions that affect the environment through clear organizational policies. Designed for managers, policy analysts, planners, and others who influence environmental decisions, the course covers choosing policy instruments, engaging stakeholders, and using impact assessment and monitoring to evaluate and improve policies. It also addresses climate resilience, compliance, trade-offs, and communicating policy choices.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly make or influence decisions with environmental implications and work with policies, regulations, or compliance frameworks. This course is designed for: Managers responsible for environmental programs, sustainability initiatives, or ESG portfolios. Policy analysts, environmental planners, and climate change officers. Public sector staff involved in environmental regulation, permitting, or compliance oversight. NGO leaders and program managers designing advocacy, conservation, or community-based environmental interventions. Corporate sustainability, ESG, or CSR professionals aligning operations with environmental standards. Environmental and social safeguards specialists working on development or infrastructure projects. Regulatory affairs and legal teams handling environmental law, licenses, and conditions. Strategy or risk managers integrating climate and environmental risk into decision making. Project managers whose projects require environmental impact assessment or environmental management plans. Anyone who must translate environmental commitments into policy, procedures, and accountable action.
modules: Environmental Impact Assessment and Strategic Assessment
Integrating Climate Change and Resilience into Policy
Environmental Governance in the Public and NGO Sectors
Communicating and Advocating for Environmental Policy
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of environmental issues and policy frameworks. Experience in policy, regulation, or environmental management is beneficial but not mandatory.
